summary: Check updateMany count before auditing a conversation status transition so zero-row persistence cannot report success.
Preserve tenant-scoped lookup, allowed transitions, and one-row audit behavior.
limits: Five runtime cases execute actual conversation service, permission policy and error helpers with transaction/repository/audit adapters. No native Prisma, HTTP, SQL or rollback execution.
The new count check detects a non-single-row update; repository write predicates do not compare the old status. It does not prevent stale-state transition races or prove concurrent safety.
